description: Divisional Secretariat - Weligama - Notify the Annual Festival of Suwa Sahanaya Catholic Church Weligama, under Pilgrimage Ordinance (w.e.f. 25.11.2017 to 26.11.2017)
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the dates for an annual religious festival under the Pilgrimage Ordinance (Chapter 175). It is a legal notice published under specific regulations, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter (Type 5) rather than a government personnel/structure announcement or any other specialized category.
